I need to find which single function or method declared under internal/ in /bench/home/work has the highest inbound-call count (fan-in). 

Check these candidates by counting callers across the entire Go codebase (excluding _test.go):
1. grep -c for "ConvertStringToInt32" in all .go files (not test)
2. grep -c for "\.GenUUID\b" or "GenUUID(" in all .go files (not test)
3. grep -c for "ExtractProperties" in all .go files (not test)  
4. grep -c for "GenerateSnippet" in all .go files (not test)
5. grep -c for "HasPrefixes" in all .go files (not test)
6. grep -c for "RenderMarkdown" in all .go files (not test)
7. grep -c for "ExtractTags" in all .go files (not test)
8. grep -c for "GetServerAddress" in all .go files (not test)
9. grep -c for "ValidateURL" in all .go files (not test)
10. grep -c for "RandomString" in all .go files (not test)
11. grep -rn 'util\.' --include='*.go' internal/ server/ store/ cmd/ | grep -v _test.go | grep -oP 'util\.\w+' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head 10 - to find the most-called util functions

Also check:
12. grep -c for "Compile\b" or "\.Compile(" from internal/filter
13. grep -c for "CompileToStatement" from internal/filter
14. Count calls to internal/base functions

Report the function with the highest count and its approximate fan-in number, with the file where it's declared.
